rootDecorators.name: initProtonPass
rootDecorators.description: Initialize a Proton Pass plugin instance for protonPass() resolver

dataTypes.name: protonPassSecretRef
dataTypes.typeDescription: Proton Pass secret reference in the format `pass://vault/item/field`

docs.description: Secret reference syntax for Proton Pass CLI

validationRules.message: Secret reference must be in format `pass://<vault>/<item>/<field>` (exactly 3 components)

dataTypes.name: protonPassPassword
dataTypes.typeDescription: Proton Pass account password used by `pass-cli login --interactive`

validationRules.message: Password must be a non-empty string

dataTypes.name: protonPassTotp
dataTypes.typeDescription: Proton Pass TOTP code used by `pass-cli login --interactive` (if 2FA is enabled)

validationRules.message: TOTP must be a non-empty string

dataTypes.name: protonPassExtraPassword
dataTypes.typeDescription: Proton Pass extra password used by `pass-cli login --interactive` (if required by your account)

validationRules.message: Extra password must be a non-empty string

dataTypes.name: protonPassPersonalAccessToken
dataTypes.typeDescription: Proton Pass personal access token used by `pass-cli login` (non-interactive, recommended for CI)

docs.description: Proton Pass CLI personal access token login

validationRules.message: Personal access token must be a non-empty string
Personal access token looks malformed - expected `pst_...::TOKENKEY`
